items.title: Mandarin Oriental is reborn, 12 years and a pandemic later
items.why: Mandarin Oriental's Manila return adds a luxury Southeast Asia hotel that could matter for future hotel partner talks.
items.summary_ai: Mandarin Oriental is reopening a 275-room hotel in Manila's Ayala Triangle after the original property closed in 2014.
items.take: Mandarin Oriental's Manila return adds a luxury Southeast Asia hotel that could matter for future hotel partner talks.
